services.title: Fiber Internet (FTTH)
services.desc: Ultra-fast fiber-optic connectivity with symmetric gigabit speeds and guaranteed bandwidth for homes and businesses.

services.title: Wireless Connectivity
services.desc: Point-to-point and WISP solutions providing coverage in underserved and remote areas with carrier-grade reliability.

services.title: Enterprise Networking
services.desc: Custom-designed network architectures including SD-WAN, MPLS, and multi-site connectivity for large organizations.

services.title: Managed IT Services
services.desc: Proactive monitoring, help desk support, patch management, and complete IT operations outsourcing.

services.title: CCTV & Surveillance
services.desc: Professional IP surveillance networks with AI-powered analytics, cloud-based monitoring, and thermal imaging.

services.title: Smart Automation
services.desc: IoT integration, smart building systems, intelligent automation, and connected device ecosystems.

solutions.title: Business Connectivity
solutions.desc: Enterprise-grade connectivity solutions with dedicated fiber links, SD-WAN orchestration, and multi-site networking for mission-critical operations.

solutions.title: Smart Home Integration
solutions.desc: Seamless home automation platforms connecting lighting, security, climate, entertainment, and energy management into a unified ecosystem.

solutions.title: Smart City Infrastructure
solutions.desc: End-to-end smart city deployments integrating IoT sensors, intelligent traffic management, environmental monitoring, and connected public services.
